say:0:1013301001:0.text: ...Miss Fay, aren't you a little too close?
say:0:1013301001:0.source_cn: ……菲小姐，你和我的距离……会不会有点太近了？

say:1:1013301002:0.text: Oh my, I'm sorry! And please, just call me Fay.
say:1:1013301002:0.source_cn: 哎呀，真抱歉！请直接叫我菲。

say:2:1013301003:0.text: I wanted to get to know you better, so I moved closer without realizing.
say:2:1013301003:0.source_cn: 我刚才还在老师身边的，我很喜欢特弥希娅，才会不知不觉靠近……
say:2:1013301003:0.male: I wanted to get to know you better, so I moved closer without realizing.
say:2:1013301003:0.female: I wanted to get to know you better, so I moved closer without realizing.

say:3:1013301004:0.text: You're in heavy armor, so I shouldn't have gotten so close...
say:3:1013301004:0.source_cn: 你穿着重甲走路本就费力，我不该贴过来的……

say:4:1013301005:0.text: Don't worry, the armor's weight isn't a problem for me.
say:4:1013301005:0.source_cn: 倒是不必介意这个。对我来说，盔甲的重量不是负担。

say:0:1013302001:0.text: I remember when I first put on my armor, I couldn't even stand...
say:0:1013302001:0.source_cn: 特弥希娅比我厉害，我刚刚开始穿着重甲的时候，只是站着都...

say:1:1013302002:0.text: But now I'm used to it. I even forget to take it off to sleep! *Laughter*
say:1:1013302002:0.source_cn: 不过，现在也习惯了。偶尔还会忘记脱掉睡觉呢。嘿嘿。

say:2:1013302003:0.text: You Temple folk really have a weird sense of humor...
say:2:1013302003:0.source_cn: 搞不懂。居然在笑着说这种可怕的事，你们圣堂的人是不是都...

say:3:1013302004:0.text: You're laughing? I thought you'd never drop your guard around us!
say:3:1013302004:0.source_cn: 咦，等等，特弥希娅在笑？原来混熟之后，你也会露出这种表情啊。

say:4:1013302005:0.text: Ahem... The camp's up ahead, we're almost there.
say:4:1013302005:0.source_cn: ……有什么问题吗？请看，前方那片营地，应该就是我们的目...

say:5:1013302006:0.source_cn: 没错，就是前面的营地，我先去跟大家打个招呼！

say:0:1013303001:0.text: Great to see you all! I made it safely!
say:0:1013303001:0.source_cn: 见到大家可太高兴啦！我平安到来了！

say:1:1013303002:0.text: Are you the ones who escorted Fay here? Thank you so much!
say:1:1013303002:0.source_cn: 就是你们护送菲一路过来的吗？太感谢了！

say:2:1013303003:0.text: To be honest, we weren't expecting Fay to arrive on time...
say:2:1013303003:0.source_cn: 我们本来没指望菲能如期到达的，这下帮了大忙……

say:3:1013303004:0.text: Fay mentioned you're curious about something? Feel free to ask!
say:3:1013303004:0.source_cn: 菲说你们有想知道的事？请在营地内随意询问，我们很愿意分...

say:2:1013304001:2.text: What do you know about the <style="highlight">energy source of golems</style>?

say:3:1013304002:2.text: Hmm. What has Donn told you so far?
say:3:1013304002:2.source_cn: 你一下就问到点子上了。唐恩跟你们说了什么吗？
say:3:1013304002:2.male: Hmm. What has Donn told you so far?
say:3:1013304002:2.female: Hmm. What has Donn told you so far?

say:4:1013304003:1.text: My research has made progress. But I'm unsure if saying this in front of the Templar Knights will be seen as offensive...
say:4:1013304003:1.source_cn: 我的研究已经有所突破。但我不确定，这个结论，当着诸位圣...

say:5:1013304004:2.text: You won't arrest me and throw me in jail, right?

say:6:1013304005:1.text: The Temple respects and preserves knowledge, we'd never harm scholars. Please, go ahead.
say:6:1013304005:1.source_cn: 圣堂尊重并传承知识，从不会迫害学者。请说吧。

say:7:1013304006:1.text: Alright, listen closely. We believe the energy driving the golems' rampage is related to the <style="highlight">Faith Stone</style>!
say:7:1013304006:1.source_cn: 我可当真了哦。请听好——我们认为，驱动魔偶再次肆虐的能...

choice_prompt:8:1013304006.text: Alright, listen closely. We believe the energy driving the golems' rampage is related to the <style="highlight">Faith Stone</style>!
choice_prompt:8:1013304006.source_cn: 我可当真了哦。请听好——我们认为，驱动魔偶再次肆虐的能源与圣石有关！至少也是类似！

say:10:1013304009:1.text: The Faith Stone is a sacred treasure left by Dura, rumored to hold the goddess' power.
say:10:1013304009:1.source_cn: 圣石是艾雅遗留的秘宝，可能蕴含着女神的力量。你既然这么...

say:11:1013304010:1.text: Golems were originally machines made by humans to fight monsters, but they haven't worked for a long time.
say:11:1013304010:1.source_cn: 魔偶是上古人类对付魔物的机器，但是很长一段时间内停止活动。

say:12:1013304011:1.text: There's evidence pointing to the time when the golems stopped working is precisely when—
say:12:1013304011:1.source_cn: 有考据成果证实，魔偶停止活动的时间点，恰恰就是——

say:13:1013304012:1.text: The Faith Stone appeared in Holistone.
say:13:1013304012:1.source_cn: 圣石出现在圣石镇的时间。

say:14:1013304013:1.text: I know, it's not solid proof. But with supporting evidence from archaeological finds, it's enough for me to propose a theory.
say:14:1013304013:1.source_cn: 是，是，我知道，这不是真凭实据。但佐以考古发现中的其他...

say:15:1013304014:1.text: It's just a theory, so don't say I blasphemed the goddess! As for other aspects, ask someone else.
say:15:1013304014:1.source_cn: 是假说哦，所以，不许说我亵渎女神！至于其他方面，你们去...

say:17:1013304008:1.text: According to our research, there aren't any...
say:17:1013304008:1.source_cn: 据我们研究所知，并没有……

choice:8:1:2.text: Are there any other Faith Stones?
choice:8:1:2.male: Are there any other Faith Stones?
choice:8:1:2.female: Are there any other Faith Stones?

say:1:1013305001:2.text: It's surprising to see so many people in this camp, especially a mix of magisters and Templar Knights.
say:1:1013305001:2.source_cn: 很少在这个营地看到这么多人，尤其是魔法师和圣骑士的组合...
say:1:1013305001:2.male: It's surprising to see so many people in this camp, especially a mix of magisters and Templar Knights.
say:1:1013305001:2.female: It's surprising to see so many people in this camp, especially a mix of magisters and Templar Knights.

say:2:1013305002:1.text: What research are you conducting here?
say:2:1013305002:1.source_cn: ……言归正传。你们在这里做的是什么研究？

say:3:1013305003:1.text: We planned to research the Faith Stone, but it's been stolen. So now we're focusing on historical records.
say:3:1013305003:1.source_cn: 我们本想研究圣石的，但圣石已经失窃。就只能先从史料入手。

say:4:1013305004:1.text: For instance, the area where the Faith Stone first appeared—
say:4:1013305004:1.source_cn: 比如说圣石第一次出现的区域——

say:7:1013305006:1.text: Yup! At this small ruin behind us.
say:7:1013305006:1.source_cn: 没错！正是我们身后的这片小型遗址。

say:8:1013305007:1.text: I gotta say, even though I lived in Holistone for a long time, I was never that curious about the Faith Stone.
say:8:1013305007:1.source_cn: 我必须说，在圣石镇讨了这么久的生活，我居然一直都没怎么...

say:9:1013305008:1.text: The general mentioned that the stone was previously fixed on the pedestal in the town's center.
say:9:1013305008:1.source_cn: 只是听将军说过，那块石头之前一直镶嵌在镇中心的台座上。

say:10:1013305009:1.text: Until it vanished, and we have no idea where it went... Just to be clear, I had nothing to do with it.
say:10:1013305009:1.source_cn: 直到被盗，下落不明……事先声明，可不是我干的。

say:13:1013305011:2.text: Ah, I forgot you don't have a sense of humor.

say:15:1013305012:1.text: Valen, don't be harsh... Temesia was in charge of investigating the theft of the Faith Stone.
say:15:1013305012:1.source_cn: 维伦，你不了解！当年负责追查圣石失窃一事的，正是特弥希娅。

say:16:1013305013:1.text: It even delayed her promotion, it's so unfair!
say:16:1013305013:1.source_cn: 因为这件事还耽误升职，真是冤枉！

say:17:1013305014:1.text: Even though Temesia couldn't nab the thief or recover the Faith Stone, she finished all the tasks assigned by the Temple!
say:17:1013305014:1.source_cn: 特弥希娅虽然没能带回案犯和圣石，但是把圣堂交待的任务都...

say:19:1013305015:1.text: That's horrible! How could they do this to someone so responsible and kind like Temesia?!
say:19:1013305015:1.source_cn: 太过分了！怎么能这么做！特弥希娅姐姐是一个尽责又善良的...

say:22:1013305017:2.text: Oh! Thanks for pointing it out!

say:23:1013305018:1.text: Anyways, I think you might have more information about the Faith Stone, right?
say:23:1013305018:1.source_cn: 我想，你能提供给我们更多有关圣石的情报，是吗？

say:26:1013305019:3.text: Wow! Way to change the topic. Anyways, let me think...
say:26:1013305019:3.source_cn: 哇！话题转得真快。让我想想，如果你们还有想知道的事……

say:28:1013305020:1.text: If you want to know anything else, maybe you should go to the stone tablet site.
say:28:1013305020:1.source_cn: 或许你们可以去石刻遗址看看，亲眼见证圣石的历史。

choice:21:0:1.text: Ahem, Lucius, your helmet is crooked.
choice:21:0:1.source_cn: 咳咳，卢修斯，你的翼冠歪了
choice:21:0:1.male: Ahem, Lucius, your helmet is crooked.
choice:21:0:1.female: Ahem, Lucius, your helmet is crooked.

choice:21:1:2.text: Let's go back to the Faith Stone.
choice:21:1:2.source_cn: 我们想知道更多圣石的历史
choice:21:1:2.male: Let's go back to the Faith Stone.
choice:21:1:2.female: Let's go back to the Faith Stone.

say:0:1013306001:0.source_cn: 石刻遗址的位置在哪里？我们如何过去？

say:1:1013306002:0.text: Go find Asma, she's heading there too.
say:1:1013306002:0.source_cn: 去找阿斯玛吧，她也正要过去，还能给你们介绍一些研究成果。
say:1:1013306002:0.male: Go find Asma, she's heading there too.
say:1:1013306002:0.female: Go find Asma, she's heading there too.

say:1:1013307002:0.text: No need for formalities here; this camp's so small.
say:1:1013307002:0.source_cn: 不用多做介绍啦，这个营地那么小，我已经听到你们的谈话了。

say:2:1013307003:0.text: Let's check out the stone tablets in the nearby ruins!
say:2:1013307003:0.source_cn: 旁边的遗址里有一些圣石的石刻，具体内容我们到了再看。方...

say:0:1013308001:0.text: There are tons of monsters... I'll stick close to the Magister!
say:0:1013308001:0.source_cn: 哇，这附近有好多怪物……我要跟紧老师！
say:0:1013308001:0.male: There are tons of monsters... I'll stick close to the Magister!
say:0:1013308001:0.female: There are tons of monsters... I'll stick close to the Magister!

say:1:1013308002:0.text: I wonder what role the Syndicate plays...
say:1:1013308002:0.source_cn: 如果说魔偶的能源与圣石有关……黑金商会又扮演了什么样的...
say:1:1013308002:0.male: I wonder what role the Syndicate plays...
say:1:1013308002:0.female: I wonder what role the Syndicate plays...

say:2:1013308003:0.text: You're so good at multitasking, teach me your ways!
say:2:1013308003:0.source_cn: 老师一脸心事重重的样子，怪物却消灭得飞快呢！也指点指点我吧！
say:2:1013308003:0.male: You're so good at multitasking, teach me your ways!
say:2:1013308003:0.female: You're so good at multitasking, teach me your ways!

say:3:1013309001:2.text: You guys really are amazing. Especially you, Magister, I've never seen spells like the ones you use...
say:3:1013309001:2.source_cn: 你们几个……还真不简单。尤其是菲的老师，刚才使用的法术...
say:3:1013309001:2.male: You guys really are amazing. Especially you, Magister, I've never seen spells like the ones you use...
say:3:1013309001:2.female: You guys really are amazing. Especially you, Magister, I've never seen spells like the ones you use...

say:4:1013309002:3.text: Of course! Since Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> is the great almighty Mer... Ahh! Chippy, why are you covering my mouth?!
say:4:1013309002:3.male: Of course! Since Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> is the great almighty Mer... Ahh! Chippy, why are you covering my mouth?!
say:4:1013309002:3.female: Of course! Since Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> is the great almighty Mer... Ahh! Chippy, why are you covering my mouth?!

say:6:1013309003:1.text: Don't go flaunting <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s identity everywhere! It'll only cause trouble for him!
say:6:1013309003:1.source_cn: 不许拿主人的身份到处炫耀！这样会给<style=str...
say:6:1013309003:1.male: Don't go flaunting <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s identity everywhere! It'll only cause trouble for him!
say:6:1013309003:1.female: Don't go flaunting <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s identity everywhere! It'll only cause trouble for her!

choice_prompt:7:1013309003.text: Don't go flaunting <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s identity everywhere! It'll only cause trouble for him!
choice_prompt:7:1013309003.source_cn: 不许拿主人的身份到处炫耀！这样会给<style=stress><player_name></style>大人添麻烦的！
choice_prompt:7:1013309003.male: Don't go flaunting <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s identity everywhere! It'll only cause trouble for him!
choice_prompt:7:1013309003.female: Don't go flaunting <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s identity everywhere! It'll only cause trouble for her!

say:8:1013309004:2.source_cn: 啊？啊？老师在说什么？嗯，<hpy>我突然听不见了……...

say:9:1013309005:1.text: ... Fay!! Stop pretending like you didn't just spill a massive secret!
say:9:1013309005:1.source_cn: 你你你！这时候开始装听不见了，好假！

say:12:1013309006:2.text: Alright guys, we shouldn't forget what we came here to do.
say:12:1013309006:2.source_cn: 好啦好啦，办正事要紧。我们的大魔法师也是这么想得吧？
say:12:1013309006:2.male: Alright guys, we shouldn't forget what we came here to do.
say:12:1013309006:2.female: Alright guys, we shouldn't forget what we came here to do.

choice_prompt:13:1013309006.text: Alright guys, we shouldn't forget what we came here to do.
choice_prompt:13:1013309006.source_cn: 好啦好啦，办正事要紧。我们的大魔法师也是这么想得吧？
choice_prompt:13:1013309006.male: Alright guys, we shouldn't forget what we came here to do.
choice_prompt:13:1013309006.female: Alright guys, we shouldn't forget what we came here to do.

say:14:1013309007:2.text: It's just ahead! The place where the Faith Stone first appeared, according to the records.
say:14:1013309007:2.source_cn: 各位，就是前面那里！有记载以来圣石第一次出现的地方。

choice:7:0:1.text: I never agreed to be her mentor...
choice:7:0:1.source_cn: 其实没答应过当她老师……
choice:7:0:1.male: I never agreed to be her mentor...
choice:7:0:1.female: I never agreed to be her mentor...

choice:7:1:2.text: At this point, can we still deny it?
choice:7:1:2.source_cn: 事到如今，还可以否认吗？
choice:7:1:2.male: At this point, can we still deny it?
choice:7:1:2.female: At this point, can we still deny it?

say:0:1013310001:0.text: Here are the stone tablets; I'll explain them for you.
say:0:1013310001:0.source_cn: 小心地查看这些石碑吧，我会为诸位讲解。

say:1:1013310002:0.text: Let me see—Whoa! I almost tripped, that was close!
say:1:1013310002:0.source_cn: 老师，这些事让我来做就行了——咿呀呀呀！差点摔倒，好危险！
say:1:1013310002:0.male: Let me see—Whoa! I almost tripped, that was close!
say:1:1013310002:0.female: Let me see—Whoa! I almost tripped, that was close!

say:0:1013311001:0.text: Some text is missing, but you can still make out some info.
say:0:1013311001:0.source_cn: 文字缺失一部分，但仍然能看出一些信息。

say:1:1013311002:0.text: Let's ask Asma for more information.
say:1:1013311002:0.source_cn: 去找阿斯玛老师问问看吧。
say:1:1013311002:0.male: Let's ask Asma for more information.
say:1:1013311002:0.female: Let's ask Asma for more information.

say:1:1013312001:1.text: Thanks for gathering the info, everyone. Now, let's take a look...
say:1:1013312001:1.source_cn: 辛苦诸位收集石碑。那么，请看……

say:2:1013312002:0.text: This stone tablet records local legends, linking the Faith Stone and the Divine War.
say:2:1013312002:0.source_cn: 这块石碑上记录着本地传说，表明圣石与神魔大战有关。

say:3:1013312003:1.text: This lines up with some official statements from the Temple. Many believe the Faith Stone was left by Dura.
say:3:1013312003:1.source_cn: 这也与圣堂的部分官方说法有所印证。虽然没有考据支持，但...

say:5:1013312004:1.source_cn: 确实如此，圣石是为女神遗留下的珍宝。

say:7:1013312005:1.text: That raises a question... Why was the Faith Stone left in Holistone, rather than with the Temple?
say:7:1013312005:1.source_cn: 那么问题来了，女神的珍宝为什么没有被圣堂供奉，反而留在...

say:8:1013312006:1.text: Good question! Unfortunately, neither side of the war recorded that info, so there's no explanation...
say:8:1013312006:1.source_cn: 绝妙的问题！中间似乎有一些故事，但是双方都没有记载，因...

say:0:1013313001:0.text: Phew! The ruins are safe again thanks to you all. Let's continue examining the tablets.
say:0:1013313001:0.source_cn: 呼，多亏了诸位！遗址的安全再次得到保障，请继续查看石碑。

say:1:1013313002:0.text: The magister fighting with Temesia is truly a sight to behold!
say:1:1013313002:0.source_cn: 老师的魔法能力，特弥希娅姐姐的英姿，太帅了！
say:1:1013313002:0.male: The magister fighting with Temesia is truly a sight to behold!
say:1:1013313002:0.female: The magister fighting with Temesia is truly a sight to behold!

say:2:1013313003:0.text: Hey! Lucius and I pitched in too. Give us some credit, huh?
say:2:1013313003:0.source_cn: 喂，菲，我和卢修斯也出力了。也夸夸我们呀？

say:3:1013313004:0.text: *Giggle* Let's just stick to researching these tablets!
say:3:1013313004:0.source_cn: 才不要！接着研究石碑去咯！

say:1:1013314001:1.text: These two tablets record the Faith Stone moving to the center of Holistone. That's how the town got its name.
say:1:1013314001:1.source_cn: 这两块石碑，上面记录了人们将圣石移至圣石镇中心。圣石镇...

say:2:1013314002:1.text: It was found that at that time, the golems simultaneously fell into slumber.
say:2:1013314002:1.source_cn: 我们在本地走访得知，当时尚没有被称为魔偶的傀儡们，也几...

say:3:1013314003:1.text: The fact that the golems have started moving again has got many speculating about the connection between them and the Faith Stone.
say:3:1013314003:1.source_cn: 魔偶最近重新开始活动，引发了我们对圣石和魔偶关联的猜测。

say:4:1013314004:1.text: But this research isn't my specialty. Hmm... wait a minute. Have you been to the <style="highlight">Ancient Battlefield</style>?
say:4:1013314004:1.source_cn: 但这部分研究，并不是我的专长。唔……等等。你们去过<s...

choice_prompt:5:1013314004.text: But this research isn't my specialty. Hmm... wait a minute. Have you been to the <style="highlight">Ancient Battlefield</style>?
choice_prompt:5:1013314004.source_cn: 但这部分研究，并不是我的专长。唔……等等。你们去过<style=stress>傀儡古战场</style>吗？

say:6:1013314005:1.text: If you're investigating the golems, it might be worth visiting the Ancient Battlefield.
say:6:1013314005:1.source_cn: 如果诸位想追查魔偶，倒是不妨去傀儡古战场看看。

say:7:1013314006:1.text: Historical records say it's filled with tons of dormant golems. It's also where people first witnessed the golems attacking humans.
say:7:1013314006:1.source_cn: 史料记载，古战场沉睡着大量的傀儡。那附近也是最早有人目...

say:9:1013314007:2.text: I see. Has your team checked it out?
say:9:1013314007:2.source_cn: 原来如此。你们去考察过吗？

say:10:1013314008:1.text: Well... we really wanted to go. We were about to set up camp there, and even had everything mapped out...
say:10:1013314008:1.source_cn: 这个…… 想去的，肯定是想去的。我们曾试图在那边设立营...

say:11:1013314009:1.text: Until we realized that the golems nearby were becoming active, and it became too dangerous for us.
say:11:1013314009:1.source_cn: 后来才发现，这一路上魔偶都已渐渐开始活动，实在太不安全...

say:12:1013314010:1.text: If you're planning to go, take this map! For now, we'll just focus on researching the nearby ruins. I'm hoping Fay's talents can help us there!
say:12:1013314010:1.source_cn: 要是你们打算前往，就收下这张地图吧！现在，我还是打算专...

say:14:1013314011:1.source_cn: 我也很开心！能帮上大家的忙就太好啦！

choice_prompt:15:1013314011.source_cn: 我也很开心！能帮上大家的忙就太好啦！

say:16:1013314012:1.text: Best of luck at the Ancient Battlefield!
say:16:1013314012:1.source_cn: 好说好说！也祝你们在傀儡古战场有新发现！

say:17:1013314013:1.text: Huh?... Oh, I just realized... Are we splitting from the magister and Temesia? I'm really gonna miss you guys...
say:17:1013314013:1.source_cn: 诶？……我才反应过来……要跟老师和特弥希娅姐姐分开了吗...
say:17:1013314013:1.male: Huh?... Oh, I just realized... Are we splitting from the magister and Temesia? I'm really gonna miss you guys...
say:17:1013314013:1.female: Huh?... Oh, I just realized... Are we splitting from the magister and Temesia? I'm really gonna miss you guys...

say:18:1013314014:1.text: I hate parting with you two, but you have your own things to do... Lemme... see you off...
say:18:1013314014:1.source_cn: 真舍不得啊……但你们也有事情。我，我送送你们……

choice:15:0:1.text: Then I'll leave Fay with you guys.
choice:15:0:1.male: Then I'll leave Fay with you guys.
choice:15:0:1.female: Then I'll leave Fay with you guys.

say:5:1013315003:2.text: This girl can't seem to decide if she'll miss the magister or Temesia more. Look how close she's sticking to her!
say:5:1013315003:2.source_cn: 有些人，嘴上说着不舍得老师，身体却紧紧贴着特弥希娅呢。
say:5:1013315003:2.male: This girl can't seem to decide if she'll miss the magister or Temesia more. Look how close she's sticking to her!
say:5:1013315003:2.female: This girl can't seem to decide if she'll miss the magister or Temesia more. Look how close she's sticking to her!

say:8:1013315004:1.text: It's no surprise Temesia's still a hit with the girls!
say:8:1013315004:1.source_cn: 不愧是特弥希娅，还是这么受女孩子欢迎啊！

say:10:1013315005:2.text: Ahem... Well, Fay, you've escorted us a long way. Stay safe on your way back.
say:10:1013315005:2.source_cn: 我倒是没注意过这种事……菲，你已经送我们走出这么长一段...

say:11:1013315006:2.text: You too, Temesia! Take care! And... can I tell you a little secret?
say:11:1013315006:2.source_cn: 特弥希娅也是！一定要保重自己！可以偷偷告诉你一个秘密吗？

say:13:1013315008:1.text: I really like you! 'Cause you're... <style="highlight">really special</style>. You know what I mean, right?
say:13:1013315008:1.source_cn: 我很喜欢特弥希娅哦！因为特弥希娅……<style=st...

say:14:1013315009:1.text: I'm not exactly sure what you're talking about...

say:15:1013315010:1.text: I think you've got a lot on your plate. We're not really that close yet, so maybe I don't get how you're feeling, but...
say:15:1013315010:1.source_cn: 我想，特弥希娅一定背负了很多。我还不是特弥希娅的好朋友...

say:16:1013315011:1.text: Since you're shouldering so many things by yourself, at least be kind to yourself, okay?
say:16:1013315011:1.source_cn: 既然无论如何都只能由你自己背负，至少对自己好一点，好吗...

say:18:1013315013:1.text: Thanks for caring. You're sweet, but I shouldn't wish for what I don't deserve.
say:18:1013315013:1.source_cn: 多谢关心。你真善良，但我不该去奢求我不配得到的东西。

say:19:1013315014:1.text: After I atone for my sins, maybe the merciful Dura will grant me a moment of peace...
say:19:1013315014:1.source_cn: 在罪孽赎清之后，也许仁慈的艾雅会赐给我片刻安宁吧……

say:20:1013315015:1.text: Take care on your journey, Fay. Don't worry about me.
say:20:1013315015:1.source_cn: 一路保重，菲，请别为我担心了。

say:1:1013317001:1.text: It's quite lively here. It's rare to see this many living people in this area.
say:1:1013317001:1.source_cn: 真热闹啊。这片遗址可难得见到这么多活人。

say:3:1013317002:2.text: Atalanta! Fancy seeing you here! You actually left the Dark Forest?
say:3:1013317002:2.source_cn: 阿塔兰忒……又见面了！你竟然从薄暮丛林离开了？

say:5:1013317003:2.text: Seems like you have friends from all over, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. You've got quite the connections!
say:5:1013317003:2.source_cn: 在这种荒山野岭都能遇到朋友？<style=stress...
say:5:1013317003:2.male: Seems like you have friends from all over, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. You've got quite the connections!
say:5:1013317003:2.female: Seems like you have friends from all over, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. You've got quite the connections!

say:9:1013317005:2.text: I could ask the same of you!

choice_prompt:10:1013317005.text: I could ask the same of you!

say:11:1013317006:2.text: I think we may have similar goals at the moment...
say:11:1013317006:2.source_cn: 或许，跟你们的目的差不多。

say:12:1013317007:0.text: I'm pretty familiar with this area. Hold on, let me guess where you're going!
say:12:1013317007:0.source_cn: 这个地方我熟。你们想去的地方——先别说话，让我猜猜。

say:13:1013317008:1.text: Could you be... heading to the Ancient Battlefield?
say:13:1013317008:1.source_cn: 目的地是前方的营地？看反应不像……等等，莫非要去傀儡古战场？

say:15:1013317009:1.text: <shk>Wow, she got it correct on her first guess! So smart!</shk>
say:15:1013317009:1.male: <shk>Wow, she got it correct on her first guess! So smart!</shk>
say:15:1013317009:1.female: <shk>Wow, she got it correct on her first guess! So smart!</shk>

say:16:1013317010:1.source_cn: 哈，一下就试出来了。真可爱。

say:18:1013317011:0.text: I can't believe we were that obvious...
say:18:1013317011:0.source_cn: 你好好问，我们也会告诉你的呀……

say:20:1013317012:2.text: For those who don't know me or might have forgotten me, let me reintroduce myself—Atalanta, the treasure hunter, at your service!
say:20:1013317012:2.source_cn: 向某些还不认识我或不想听到我名字的家伙，重新自我介绍一...

say:22:1013317013:2.text: The road to the Ancient Battlefield is pretty long. How about traveling together? Let me be your guide.
say:22:1013317013:2.source_cn: 从这里去傀儡古战场路途不近。不如搭伴而行，让我来当你们...

say:24:1013317014:2.text: A treasure hunter... What brings you to this archaeological site?
say:24:1013317014:2.source_cn: 寻宝猎人……跑来这遗址附近干什么？

say:25:1013317015:2.text: What else does a treasure hunter do when visiting an archaeological site? You tell me.
say:25:1013317015:2.source_cn: 寻宝猎人造访遗址还能来干什么？你来告诉我啊。

say:32:1013317020:1.source_cn: 老师老师，她刚才是不是提议做你们的向导？要是能一路同行...

say:39:1013317025:1.source_cn: 不过话说回来，我同意这位阿塔兰忒小姐。追查魔偶可不是游...
